_comment: groundTruth: authored from the documented table (docs/wiki/telemetry.md 'telemetry.json' locations; tit/paths.py PathManager.user_config_dir). The host directory every launcher mounts at /root/.config/ti-toolbox (telemetry consent, prefs). Rule: macOS <home>/.config/ti-toolbox always (XDG_CONFIG_HOME ignored: a Dock launch never sees a shell's); Windows %APPDATA%\ti-toolbox when APPDATA is set and non-empty, else <home>\AppData\Roaming\ti-toolbox (XDG ignored); Linux and anything else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ti-toolbox when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set and non-empty, else <home>/.config/ti-toolbox. Paths are joined in the platform's own syntax. Absent keys are unset variables. Read by tests/test_launch_contract.py (tit.launch; loader.sh for the non-Windows rows) and desktop/tests/unit/launch-contract.test.ts (userConfigDir).
